input.summary: Use the G-E-A-R-S bank to reach Gear 4, then start Gear Shift Multiball at the scoop. Make a drop-target or mini-Jackpot shot to light the Super Jackpot. Complete the three small N2O targets, then hit the far-left N2O Boost target for 2x before collecting it.

quickInfo.name: Gear Shift Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Reach gear 3 or higher, then shoot the scoop to start that gear's one-time Multiball.

quickInfo.name: N2O
quickInfo.summary: Complete the three small N2O targets, then hit the far-left N2O Boost target to start temporary 2x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: FORD add-a-ball
quickInfo.summary: Spell FORD in the bottom lanes, then shoot the scoop during Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Burnout Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell 1-8-0 at the captive ball, then shoot the lit scoop to start Burnout Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Silverball Stampede
quickInfo.summary: Complete the required modes and Multiballs to reach the final feature.

steps.text: Hold the left flipper during the plunge. Hit the A segment of the G-E-A-R-S bank while it is lit to advance two gears, up to Gear 4.
Complete the G-E-A-R-S drop targets to shift one gear at a time. Continue until Gear 4 is reached.
modeNotes: Gear Shift qualification: Gear 3 lights the scoop. Gears 5 and 6 need the standup targets after the bank within short timers.

steps.text: Reach gear 4 and shoot the scoop to start Gear 4 Multiball.
Make the first lit drop or mini-Jackpot to light the Super Jackpot. Collect the Super Jackpot at the indicated shot.
modeNotes: On code 1.45, the Gear 4 Super Jackpot has a 10,000,000 base value.

steps.text: Complete the three small N2O targets, then hit the far-left N2O Boost target to start temporary 2x playfield scoring before the Super Jackpot.
Spell FORD in the bottom lanes. Shoot the scoop to add a ball.
Complete the three RPM targets to start their timed scoring, then keep hitting the bank to restart its timer.

fallback.title: Gear 3 Multiball
fallback.when: Use this as the first available Gear Shift Multiball.

steps.text: Complete G-E-A-R-S until Gear 3 lights the scoop.
Shoot the scoop to start Gear 3 Multiball.
Spell F-O-R-D in the bottom lanes, then shoot the scoop during Multiball to add a ball.

alternatives.title: Burnout Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this as the separate captive-ball Multiball route.

steps.text: Shoot the lit scoop to start Burnout Multiball.
Shoot the left ramp, captive ball, and right orbit for the opening Jackpots.
Play each unique Gear Shift Multiball once.
Spell MUSTANG to qualify the four-ball Mustang Multiball.
Complete the six modes and the other required features.
Start Silverball Stampede after the final qualification is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: Gear shift
playfieldReferences.description: The cabinet control used to advance gears and make race decisions.

playfieldReferences.label: Left ramp
playfieldReferences.description: A major race and multiball shot whose return should be tested early.

playfieldReferences.label: Right orbit
playfieldReferences.description: A major shot used by modes and model-specific feature progress.

techniques.name: Super Skill Shot gear advance
techniques.instruction: Hold the left flipper during the plunge. Time the A shot to advance two gears, but stop before gear 5.

cautions.issue: The gear 5 and 6 qualifications require timed standup hits after the GEARS bank.
cautions.response: Gear 3 and Gear 4 do not require the timed standup sequence used by Gears 5 and 6.

cautions.issue: Code 1.45 can carry a Burnout Combo Jackpot value between competition games.
cautions.response: A competition organizer should reset the machine before play so the carried value does not affect the game.

input.simpleOverview: Mustang uses the G-E-A-R-S drop bank to raise the current gear; once Gear 3 is reached, the scoop starts that gear's one-time Gear Shift Multiball. Spell 1-8-0 at the captive ball, then shoot the lit scoop to start Burnout Multiball. Complete the three small N2O targets, then hit the far-left N2O Boost target to start temporary 2x playfield scoring.
input.overview: Mustang makes each Gear Shift Multiball available only once, with higher gears raising its Super Jackpot value. Complete the G-E-A-R-S bank until Gear 4 is reached, then shoot the scoop to start Gear 4 Multiball. Make a drop-target or mini-Jackpot shot to light the Super Jackpot; complete the three small N2O targets and hit the far-left N2O Boost target to start 2x before collecting it.

content.summary: Complete G-E-A-R-S and shoot the scoop for Gear 3 Multiball, or spell 1-8-0 at the captive ball and shoot the scoop for Burnout Multiball.
